abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Heart and Shadow, and -1 to Edge. You may start with either the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.11de92d262291440]{Scavenger} asset or the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.d7fbe5fded75531c]{Scoundrel} asset (you still get your usual starting assets).

Hoverer: You may hover slightly off the ground using your wings. In any situation where that might be advantageous (escaping over lava while being chased by non-flying enemies, preventing yourself from falling into a trap in the floor, etc.), add +1 to any move involving maneuvering in that moment.
